issues.legal_issue: The preparation, finalization, and approval of a development plan under the Town and Country Planning Act are exercises of delegated legislative power.
The National Green Tribunal cannot direct a delegatee to exercise delegated legislative power in a particular manner.
Observations in an earlier judgment concerning the National Green Tribunal’s authority to alter statutory planning requirements did not constitute a binding precedent on that issue.
The National Green Tribunal should not continue proceedings on an issue when the High Court exercising supervisory jurisdiction is already seized of the same matter.
The development plan could not be invalidated solely for conflicting with the National Green Tribunal’s earlier order after that order was found legally unsustainable.
Development planning must balance developmental needs with the protection of the environment and ecology.
